title: Code-Guided Video Editing with Source-Grounded Executable Proxies
author: Yuanhong Zheng

categories.title: Camera editing
categories.description: Make the target composition visible before the final video is synthesized.

cases.title: A wider view of the clock tower
cases.edit: Reframe the clock tower as a wide shot.
cases.observation: Without a proxy, the framing stays close to the source. The guided result reveals more of the surrounding scene.

cases.title: More sea around the sailboat
cases.edit: Widen the view while retaining the sailboat.
cases.observation: The no-proxy result keeps the close framing and cropped sails. The guided result reveals the full sailboat and more surrounding sea.

categories.title: Object addition
categories.description: Give new objects a concrete location, scale, and behavior in the existing shot.

cases.title: A seagull without losing the sailboat
cases.edit: Add a flying seagull in the upper-left sky.
cases.observation: The baseline adds the bird but removes the original sailboat. Proxy guidance adds the seagull while retaining the boat and rocky coast.

cases.title: A seagull on the sunset beach
cases.edit: Add a standing seagull near the shoreline.
cases.observation: Without a proxy, the wide beach scene becomes a close-up of the bird. The guided result adds a seagull on the sand while retaining the sunset and wide composition.

categories.title: Local modification
categories.description: Specify the intended change while giving the rest of the scene a persistent reference.

cases.title: An armored vehicle in the original chase
cases.edit: Replace the car with a matte green armored military vehicle, retaining its position and pose.
cases.observation: The baseline turns the vehicle to face the camera and loses the game interface. The guided result keeps the rear chase view, route display, and presenter inset.

cases.title: A new desk, the same office
cases.edit: Replace the desk with a rustic farmhouse-style wooden desk.
cases.observation: The baseline removes the stacked document trays and replaces the black office chair. Proxy guidance changes the desk while retaining both original items.

categories.title: Object removal
categories.description: Render the desired scene without the selected entity, then let the video model realize it.

cases.title: Remove the surrounding keyboard
cases.edit: Remove the crescent-shaped keyboard around the piano.
cases.observation: The keyboard ring remains throughout the no-proxy output. The guided result removes the ring while retaining the central piano.

categories.title: Background replacement
categories.description: Plan a new environment while retaining the foreground subject.

cases.title: A new set, the same speaker
cases.edit: Replace the newsroom with a futuristic cyber command center.
cases.observation: The baseline creates an empty command room and loses the speaker. The proxy-guided result retains her in the new environment.

categories.title: Creative transformation
categories.description: Use procedural shapes and effects to give an imagined transformation a visible plan.

categories.title: Global stylization
categories.description: Give the requested visual treatment a concrete procedural preview.

cases.title: A portrait in graphic color
cases.edit: Render the portrait in a Pop Art aesthetic.
cases.observation: The baseline mainly recolors photographic texture. Proxy guidance adds the requested graphic outlines and halftone detail.

cases.title: Rain over the lake
cases.edit: Give the lakeside scene a rainy atmosphere.
cases.observation: The no-proxy result retains the sunny weather. The guided result introduces visible rain and a darker, cloudier atmosphere.

categories.title: Subtitle editing
categories.description: Add, replace, or remove on-screen text while retaining the source scene.

cases.title: Clean sky, no subtitle band
cases.edit: Remove the subtitles from the aerial landscape.
cases.observation: The no-proxy output retains the top caption. The guided result removes the band while retaining the landscape.

cases.title: Add a line to the night skyline
cases.edit: Add "Beneath a starless sky, city lights hum a quiet lullaby." at the bottom in white text with a black outline.
cases.observation: The baseline prints the instruction word "Add" and uses black text on a filled white banner. The guided result adds the intended sentence as white outlined text.
